cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A

mechanism: Copy a diary mark as a time change, admit that part while pretending procedural certainty, then use B's corrected room information to demand its reciprocal admission.
confusable: Not confessing confusion: A acknowledges actions but covers misunderstanding, pressing B to complete the failure account.
comparison: Missed meeting and room change differ from complaint letters routed into private storage.
seedUse: Retains changed time/changed room as complementary admissions; adds crossed-out time marking absence.
